920167.title: Witch on the Holy Night
920167.overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

1061799.title: Julián
1061799.overview: Wide-eyed Julián is about to spend the summer with a grandmother he barely knows. He is amazed to discover her treasure-trove apartment, his own Caribbean heritage and the lively Brooklyn community he is surrounded by. But most surprising of all, Julián discovers that he is, in fact, a mermaid!

1086247.title: Moss & Freud
1086247.overview: Supermodel Kate Moss embarks on a journey of self-discovery when acclaimed artist Lucian Freud offers to paint her portrait.

1131943.title: Madden
1131943.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

1135463.title: Viana – The Legend of the Golden Hearts
1135463.overview: In the north of medieval Portugal, the beautiful Ana falls in love with Thomas, a poor artisan. Her father immediately forbids their union, demanding that his daughter’s suitors produce a jewel as proof of their nobility. But the young couple refuse to give up. With the help of their faithful companions, the generosity of the townswomen and the talent of a mysterious jewellery maker, Ana and Thomas will face many challenges out of love, including the powerful and evil Duke of Aragon.

1174311.title: Devilwoman
1174311.overview: A film director try to make a good film but then realized the arrangement from producer was awful, the leading actress is not what he wished, even the important prop on set was disappeared. Director wants to make arts but he only feels the pressure from the acclaimed executive producer KIN GEN HAO. Then devilwoman appears, she met someone she loves, but when everything seem so beautiful, she realized there's a big mistake.

1177767.title: Mile End Kicks
1177767.overview: Grace Pine, a 24-year-old music critic, moves to Montreal to write a book on Alanis Morissette's Jagged Little Pill, but her plans are complicated when she becomes romantically involved with two members of an indie band she is covering and decides to become their publicist.

1209511.title: Love Insurance Kompany
1209511.overview: In 2040, an app premised on ensuring romance for all is used widely by the population. When the voice behind the app's AI realizes its misconception to true love, he embarks on a quest to prove that love does not come from a screen.

1235303.title: Baise-en-ville
1235303.overview: Sprite, a 20-year-old young adult, returns to Chelles after a breakup. To pay for his driver’s license and please his parents, he joins Allo Nettoyo, a night-time cleaning start-up in the Paris suburbs. Unable to get around without a permit, he adopts the "baise-en-ville" technique—taught by his driving instructor—which involves spending the night at girls' places of girls he meets through a dating app. Sprite struggles with this new approach to seduction.

1243943.title: Bernd - Operation Germanenkind
1243943.overview: An in-depth look at how fascism hides behind facades of a tolerant, intellectual and open-minded society.

1260263.title: The Beachnickers 3
1260263.overview: Rocha decides to foot the bill for his daughter's wedding in an island and invites his loyal colleagues, Alexandre, Lima, and Diguinho, along with their families, to the all-expenses-paid celebration. The setting seemed perfect for an unforgettable trip, but the peace is short-lived, soon giving way to a series of surprises and mishaps.

1265575.title: Faust
1265575.overview: Three artists across three generations are haunted by the demon Mephistopheles in an absurdist reconstruction of the Faustian legend.

1265831.title: Red Rocks
1265831.overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

1266791.title: Alter Ego
1266791.overview: Alex, a quiet forty-something, leads an ordinary life until new neighbours move in. The husband is Alex’s perfect lookalike… except for one thing: he has hair. Alex sinks into a growing paranoia as he becomes preoccupied with this more charismatic, brilliant and accomplished mysterious double.

1290791.title: Night Shift
1290791.overview: A night watchman encounters an unspeakable force while working at an abandoned building. His struggle for survival exposes a dark truth, dragging his sibling Kai into the terrifying events.

1298919.title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
1298919.overview: On their way to his wife's hometown in West Sumatra, Teddy and his best friend, Kevin, recklessly continue their journey at night and become lost in a forbidden area believed to be the realm of the Urang Bunian. Amidst a forest filled with supernatural terrors and illusions, they must find their way home before they disappear forever.

1314279.title: Hi!
1314279.overview: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

1315303.title: Primate
1315303.overview: College student Lucy and her friends spend their vacation at her family's home in Hawaii, which includes her pet chimpanzee, Ben. However, when Ben contracts rabies after being bitten by a rabid animal, the group must fight for their lives in order to avoid the now-violent chimp.

1339175.title: The Birthday Party
1339175.overview: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

1354471.title: Zwei am Zug
1354471.overview: Sandra, a pub landlady, meets Otis, a travel agent. The two initially clash as they learn more about each other from overheard phone calls than they would like. But they get talking, discover an amazing affinity and find each other to be valuable love advisors for their personal relationship problems. When Sandra's husband Christian meets Otis' best friend Bill by chance one day, the emotional chaos is perfect.

1378791.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
1378791.overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

1383527.title: How to Wash A Body, How to Cleanse A Soul
1383527.overview: The first time Jack ever meets Richard, his biological Dad, is two hours before Richard's funeral, where he's been asked to wash and dress the body. When Richard's lifeless body starts talking back to him, Jack realises he's got a second chance at a first meeting.

1391847.title: Gale: Yellow Brick Road
1391847.overview: Dorothy Gale’s granddaughter Emily is tormented by visions, disjointed dreams, and an unshakable sense that reality itself is unraveling. As these disturbances mount, she's drawn toward a shadow world-a dark and magical realm that shouldn't exist. Through chilling encounters and surreal revelations, Emily stumbles into the long-buried legacy of Oz—now a place of ruin, tragedy, and unspeakable horrors.

1395111.title: Five Friends 2: Mount Klawih
1395111.overview: Three years after climbing Mount Madyopuro, the five friends' friendship has grown stronger. When they reunite for Andrew's daughter's birthday, they witness the family threatened with becoming a sacrifice for a black magic ritual! They set off to accompany Andrew to Mount Klawih. However, Juna has disappeared into the realm of demons!
1395111.trailerName: 𝗦𝗘𝗞𝗔𝗪𝗔𝗡 𝗟𝗜𝗠𝗢 𝟮: 𝗚𝘂𝗻𝘂𝗻𝗴 𝗞𝗹𝗮𝘄𝗶𝗵 - 𝙊𝙛𝙛𝙞𝙘𝙞𝙖𝙡 𝙏𝙧𝙖𝙞𝙡𝙚𝙧

1401767.title: Boris Is Dead
1401767.overview: A struggling actor, working as a waiter, unwittingly becomes involved in a violent heist gone wrong, where his boss—deep in debt—has been stealing from employees and running the restaurant as a front for the mob.

1404583.title: I Remember
1404583.overview: This documentary weaves together two stories of disappearance: that of Atzin Molina, my high school friend who vanished in 2019, and that of Atzin, the Totonac rain deity, believed lost or dead amid the oil-driven devastation of Veracruz, Mexico. Through these two figures who share a name—one human, the other divine—the film traces a landscape of absence, where grief, ecological violence, and spiritual erosion become inseparable.

1415399.title: Golden Fingers
1415399.overview: Three friends are sitting on a beach, practicing for a coming out.

1417127.title: It’s All Good
1417127.overview: After taking care of his intrusive mother for years, Elie is relieved: she is cured. He can finally focus on his own life and falls in love… until his mom’s relapse. Now he has to take care of both the women in his life!

1417575.title: Bookends
1417575.overview: Nate is an excitable millennial novelist forced to leave his fabulous city life behind and move in with his grandparents after a bad breakup. But when his Holocaust-surviving grandfather Saul shows signs of cognitive decline and his grandmother Miriam refuses to acknowledge her husband’s early signs of dementia, Nate finds himself torn between his desire to escape retirement community life, family responsibilities, and an unexpected romance with his grandparents’ doctor.

1435047.title: Invictus
1435047.overview: In both work and life, Liu Hao had always been the one looked down upon. That is, until he met Cai Cai—two young souls who fell deeply in love. Just as they were brimming with confidence, ready to embark on a bright future, a sudden accident overturned their lives completely. Faced with a cruel world and a humiliating existence, they chose divergent paths of resistance...

1444711.title: Día Ocho
1444711.overview: Three stories of faith and hope, intertwined through time with the life of faith-healing priest Emiliano Tardif.

1453479.title: Blood Lines
1453479.overview: Whilst embarking on a lesbian relationship with the new girl in town, a Métis woman’s life is rocked to the core when her estranged mother returns.

1455079.title: You, Me & Tuscany
1455079.overview: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

1458215.title: The Gentleman Thief
1458215.overview: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

1465063.title: Forgotten Island
1465063.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

1472679.title: Arne Goes to Space
1472679.overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.

1475047.title: John Lennon: The Last Interview
1475047.overview: “John Lennon: The Last Interview” captures an extraordinary and intimate moment in music history – the final in-depth conversation John Lennon ever gave. On December 8, 1980, Lennon and Yoko Ono sat down with a small radio crew in their New York apartment to promote the release of their album Double Fantasy. What followed was an unfiltered, wide-ranging discussion about music, politics, fatherhood, and life. Just hours later, Lennon was killed. Directed by Steven Soderbergh, the documentary presents the complete interview for the first time, framed by reflections from those who were present, revealing a man at the height of his creative and personal powers, openly looking toward the future he would never see.

1486759.title: Seahorse
1486759.overview: Nola, a sous chef, is seeking stability after a stay in a mental health facility. After a hectic dinner shift, she crashes her bike—and wakes to find her estranged, unhoused father, standing over her. As she takes him in, old wounds resurface, and her world unravels. Caught between past and present, love and loss, Nola must navigate grief, forgiveness, and the fragile hope of healing.

1493991.title: Traces of Home
1493991.overview: Delving into the past and not shying away from the dug-up pain, a young filmmaker speaks to her Mexican mother and Palestinian father about their trying journeys into the United States. In a society with rhetoric increasingly vilifying Mexicans and Palestinians, the filmmaker picks up her camera in a bid to address the grief at the center of the generational trauma that has underscored her relationship with her family. A meditation of loss and grief relieved, ultimately, through reconciliation.

1502759.title: Jupiter
1502759.overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

1503335.title: You Won't Believe What Happened Before
1503335.overview: Two rogue journalists clash over a damning video that could topple a crooked regime. As betrayal and blackmail mount, their twisted road trip spirals into chaos, murder, and a scandal that could bring the whole system crashing down.

1510055.title: The Furious
1510055.overview: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.
1510055.trailerName: The Furious: Pertaruhan Maruah | Official Trailer

1513703.title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
1513703.overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

1518247.title: Happy Raj
1518247.overview: A city romance meets a rural family invasion. What follows is chaos, comedy, and heartfelt moments. The story unfolds as a joyful entertainer that explores love, cultural clashes, and the importance of family bonds.

1518311.title: Stardust
1518311.overview: When his father brings his new girlfriend to the seaside, a withdrawn boy is forced to share his grief with someone he doesn't want to know.

1520103.title: Stomachache
1520103.overview: A woman over works herself to the point that she begins overeating, but, after eating uncooked food, she becomes grotesquely ill and unable to work properly

1524583.title: The Tower
1524583.overview: Tereza cherishes moments of being the carefree girl she once was. She enjoys time with her boyfriend, but her thoughts drift to fears about raising Karla. She keeps her worlds apart, but one night changes everything. The Tower is a short film about losing oneself and how life's most important roles are often thrust upon us.

1524711.title: The Prayer of The Rose
1524711.overview: An emotional journey of a teenage boy asking God to liberate him from his self-inflicted downfall.

1526311.title: My Son the Junkie
1526311.overview: This is the true story of Honza, who started drinking very early. Then he tried something lighter a few times. He figured, everybody's lying, he'll never have the problem. But the drugs start to wrap around him more and more. He moves on to harder and harder, until one day he reaches for meth. We follow the story as it mercilessly plunges into the depths, alternately through the eyes of Honza and through the eyes of his parents. Their perspectives diverge more and more as Honza's lies and emerging paranoia escalate. A raw and uncompromising story of a teenager who wanted to taste everything the wide range of contemporary drugs has to offer. And the story of his parents, who are desperate to save their son, even though they are gradually losing all hope.

1530151.title: Hösten med Göran
1530151.overview: The film follows the narcissist and divorced father Göran as he tries to balance his life between having children, an expensive ADHD diagnosis and the search for love. At the same time, his best friend Alex struggles with a failing marriage. Together, they try to find joy in life, hope and maybe even love.

1530279.title: Via Negativa
1530279.overview: Dan, a young priest who has abandoned his conservative diocese after learning of the death of his estranged friend, Paul. Struggling with a deep crisis of faith, he embarks on a journey to find the older priest who once abused Paul during their time in seminary. With a wounded coyote in the back of his car, Dan drifts through the American landscape, encountering eccentric travelers, stealing a gun and other assorted trophies, singing Prince songs and stopping at roadside attractions.

1539943.title: Hanamaru Theater's Longest Day
1539943.overview: An Arasa woman who aims to make a comeback in her life and change her career to a strip dancer. On the day she came for an interview, she caught rumors about the police's care. In addition, the disappearance of dancers and the biggest pinch of the board! A story of a small theater fighting to protect the show, causing a great commotion and emotion!

1541799.title: The Beast of Gevautwo
1541799.overview: Six months after the events of the first film, we find the mayor still alive at the bar, the beast is striking again, so they’ll have to fight back...

1546855.title: It's OK
1546855.overview: Daughter Xu Ke wants to have surgery to remove the polyp from her uterus during the vacation, while her mother Hu Chunrong also plans to run away from home to escape the long-standing problems in her marriage. As the two, who both love and hurt each other, resolve to face their respective predicaments, they unexpectedly find forgiveness for each other’s fragility and imperfection in a sudden, unforeseen moment.
1546855.trailerName: 我，许可 It's OK 2026 电影预告片：定档版 (中文字幕)

1550567.title: Room 23
1550567.overview: A reporter arrives in Rijeka and is placed in a hotel room numbered 23 where he also meets a mysterious roommate with a shady past. His arrival in the city coincides with the dissappearence of a famous local musical artist. His interest sufficiently piqued, he starts an amateur investigation of his own, which traps him in the inescapable clutches of the city's criminal underworld, putting the life and safety of both him and his family at risk.

1567783.title: Mailin
1567783.overview: While telling her daughter a bedtime story, Mailin pieces her memories back together. What could have been a fairy tale turns out to be the story of a young girl who suffered abuse from a priest for 15 years. It’s a long journey towards healing and justice, but also the chance to offer her daughter the childhood she never had.

1571687.title: Justin the Just
1571687.overview: France, World War I. Justin (Alban Ivanov), an illiterate peasant farmer is enrolled in French army. Knowing nothing of the World or the War, Justin finds himself on the front without understanding why he must kill men he’s never met. Naïve and open minded, Justin will cross the path of a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, escape a prisoner camp and start a mutiny to prevent his fellow comrades to risk their lives. Through his journey Justin will question the absurdity of war, make lifetime friends and inspire many…
1571687.trailerName: My Very First World War / Justin le juste (2026) - Trailer (English Subs)

1573031.title: The Blue Suit
1573031.overview: A thrifted suit becomes a silent witness in the lives of three young men at pivotal moments in their journey to adulthood.

1575207.title: Dilan ITB 1997
1575207.overview: Dilan is an ITB student who returned from Cuba in March 1997. In the midst of the heated political situation leading up to the Reformation.
1575207.trailerName: OFFICIAL TRAILER DILAN ITB 1997  | 30 APRIL DI BIOSKOP

1577319.title: Ancestors
1577319.overview: 1988.  Dreams, memories and history collide as a young man searches for his missing friend.

1583399.title: Agnes Mot Verden
1583399.overview: Norwegian film written & directed by David B. Berget
1583399.trailerName: Agnes mot verden - trailer - på kino 20. mars

1592679.title: Oh..! Sukumari
1592679.overview: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

1594279.title: Robbin' the Hood
1594279.overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

1600743.title: Long Hot Summer Vacation
1600743.overview: Forte and Voce, illegal immigrants from Largo, show up at the house where Japanese sisters Kameko and Tsukiyo live...
1600743.trailerName: 『ロングホットサマーバケーション』予告編

1602727.title: Night King
1602727.overview: The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club’s manager, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make matters worse, the new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife.

1603175.title: 72 Hours on Gardraxis
1603175.overview: Reunited after 10 years, a father and daughter must reconcile their differences and escape a dangerous alien planet before it's too late

1604967.title: Paper Plane
1604967.overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

1606439.title: Instrucciones para reparar un sombrero
1606439.overview: Jonas, a young magician who has retired from stage, is invited to participate in a film the chaotic production forces him to confront a past trauma, while unexpectedly giving him the chance to overcome it.

1608615.title: The Way to You
1608615.overview: New Yorkers Emma and Conrad agree to help each other find their missed connections after a subway blackout. Their search might lead to love, but not where either of them expects to find it.
1608615.trailerName: Sneak Peek | The Way to You | Starring Kim Matula and Aaron O'Connell

1611111.title: Meeting the Buddha
1611111.overview: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

1616295.title: DJ Gabe: The Movie
1616295.overview: DJ Gabe: The Movie follows the inspiring journey of Gabriel Winters, a passionate musician known as DJ Gabe. The film explores his deep-rooted connection to music, faith, and his local community in Oregon. Through a blend of high-energy concert footage, intimate interviews, and behind-the-scenes stories, the movie celebrates the power of following one's calling and the impact of uplifting others through art and service.

1617191.title: Summer's Last Resort
1617191.overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

1619367.title: 3 Kilograms of Happiness
1619367.overview: Anastasia convinces Chavdar to help their daughter Betty, who is having her third miscarriage. He pays for a fourth IVF treatment with his retirement bonus, sacrificing his dream of traveling by sea with Anastasia. However, Anastasia decides to get pregnant with the embryo herself, despite her husband's protests and against her faith and the law, thus throwing the family into turbulent waters.

1619815.overview: Seventeen-year-old Sara is hiding a secret on a school trip. When the trip spirals out of control and Sara witnesses a classmate’s sexual assault, she and the girl seal a bond that will last forever.

1621159.title: Nuclear Boy
1621159.overview: The lonely 17-year-old outcast Aike craves attention and finds it online where he conducts dangerous chemistry experiments. Hoping to pull Aike out of his internet bubble, his mother, a hardworking nurse, sends him to the scouts to make real friends. When that fails, Aike feels rejected and hurt. To prove himself to the world, he begins his biggest experiment yet: he secretly builds a nuclear breeder reactor in his mother's shed, encouraged by a growing group of internet followers.

1621671.title: Time of Plenty
1621671.overview: Time of Plenty is an essayistic documentary about man-made climate change, Easter Island, and our place in the universe.  Written and directed by Robin Jensen  Narrated by Renate Reinsve  Produced by Mikrofilm AS

1626279.title: Unauthorized Love
1626279.overview: After losing her boyfriend in a car accident. Shelly hesitant about dating again, until she's introduced to the charming Les Harris, who has alternative motives.

1628071.title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
1628071.overview: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?

1632103.title: The City of the Living
1632103.overview: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

1634343.title: The Architecture of Solitude
1634343.overview: Tracing the hidden life of interiors.

1636647.title: The Quiet After
1636647.overview: In a near-future society where grief is erased by law, Noah wakes up with fragments of an unknown woman after a near-fatal accident. Drawn into therapy and reassured by a trusted friend, he begins to piece together the unbearable truth. His search for her, and for himself, becomes an act of defiance against a world that values compliance over love.  Haunted by memory and hunted by the system, Noah is forced to confront the cost of remembering, and the deeper cost of letting go.

1641319.title: Sniper: No Nation
1641319.overview: Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a rescue mission in Costa Verde when their friends are taken hostage.

1643111.title: How to Talk Australians: The Movie
1643111.overview: A group of students and teachers from The Delhi College of Linguistics hit the road to discover Australia and gain first-hand experience of its authentic language and culture. When their plane is diverted to the country town of Dubbo due to storms, and their tour-leader is detained by customs, the hapless bunch unearth the 'real' Australia while never making it to Sydney, Melbourne...or even Brisbane.

1653671.title: Almost Us
1653671.overview: A passionate one-night stand between a carefree community organizer and a closeted real estate developer ignites a battle over a Phoenix cultural center-and forces them to confront love, identity, and legacy.

1658087.title: Mosquito Halo
1658087.overview: Police investigate Dream Harvester, a political faction opposing the digitization of consciousness.

1662183.title: The Second Life of Freddie Nole
1662183.overview: When Freddie Nole drives to meet a man walking out of prison, he’s not just offering a ride, he’s offering hope, dignity, and a path to permanent freedom. As this vérité road trip unfolds, we come to learn the remarkable story behind Freddie’s mission, a staggering mistake that cost him 50 years of freedom but ultimately brings him right back to the prison door.
1662183.trailerName: THE SECOND LIFE OF FREDDIE NOLE - TRAILER

1663527.title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
1663527.overview: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial.

1666087.title: Kucing Hitam
1666087.overview: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.
1666087.trailerName: Trailer Kucing Hitam | In Theater 4 Juni 2026

1667687.title: La Lucha De Lucia
1667687.overview: Lucía “La Guerrera”, a 16-year-old Mexican lucha libre wrestler, as she struggles to find herself in the wrestling world that she grew up in. Her Father, “El Patron Enmascarado”, who has trained her from a young age, believes that she must maintain the tactics of a ruda (a wrestler who plays dirty to win) in order to have a successful wrestling career. A persona that has laid the foundation of their family’s legacy for generations and been the key to their success. Lucía is determined to challenge her family’s ways. She is left to decide if she will trust her own intuition and put up a real fight or play by the unspoken rules of the game, surrendering to the strategy that has been forced upon her.

1674087.title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
1674087.overview: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

1676967.title: i don't need a job
1676967.overview: A man ventures deeper and deeper into insanity due to the cost of AI automation and modern day internet culture.

1677415.title: Paroxysm
1677415.overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

1677927.title: Couture to the Max
1677927.overview: At just 9-years-old, fashion prodigy Max Alexander fearlessly fuses his boundless imagination with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, inspiring us to dream boldly and act responsibly.

1678247.title: Очень сказочные дела
1678247.overview: All the inhabitants of the Far Far Away Kingdom are obsessed with three glorious heroes. Their battles are like rock concerts: they draw crowds of fans, merchandise is sold on every corner, and every child dreams of being like them. Among them is forty-year-old Elemelya, a simple-minded and awkward boy who also happens to be the president of the Three Heroes fan club, which includes three other children. At the royal feast, trying to get closer to his idols, Elemelya accidentally disrupts the knights secret operation to capture Koschey Bedrosovich. Koschey disappears along with the royal daughter. Now Elemelya is despised by everyone: the people, the tsar, his own fan club-but most importantly, he has disappointed his idols. To set things right, Elemelya, along with the chatty gusli player Alyoshka, sets off on a long journey to Koshchey's underbelly.

1679399.title: David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth
1679399.overview: A 90-minute special, broadcast from the Royal Albert Hall, London, celebrating Sir David Attenborough's groundbreaking career on the day of his 100th birthday.

1683175.title: Behind the 8 Ball
1683175.overview: A financially troubled high school senior bets her future on a pool tournament, only to discover that the real game is deciding what kind of life she wants to live.

1684839.title: Wochenendrebellen 2
1684839.overview: When Mirco and Fatime realize that their 15-year-old autistic son, Jason, is experiencing puberty from a perspective all his own, Mirco sees an opportunity in a new promise: Together, father and son embark on an extraordinary journey through Germany’s soccer clubs to raise funds for the construction of a well in Kenya and, in the process, test Jason’s independence.

1686823.title: The Greek Aisle
1686823.overview: When Georgia travels to the Greek island of Corfu to finalize an inheritance, she unexpectedly discovers that marrying her handsome co-inheritor is the only way to meet the requirements.

1688039.title: A Message
1688039.overview: A Message is a short-form documentary draft capturing the raw, unmediated protests and performances of queer Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush while facing pink washing propaganda. Created by trans Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush, this film rejects the flattening narrative of tragedy. Instead, it posits Palestinian Futurism - a framework where those in exile are not merely survivors, but the architects of a liberated cultural and political future.

1688935.title: Oye Bhole Oye 2
1688935.overview: A simple village boy refuses to sell his land when a powerful company offers big money, even as his own family gives in. As he stands alone, his fight turns from a personal struggle into a larger battle to protect his roots and expose the truth behind the project.
1688935.trailerName: Oye Bhole Oye 2 (Movie Trailer) Jagjeet Sandhu | New Punjabi Movie 2026 | Movie in Cinemas 12th June

1689767.title: All Our Yesterdays
1689767.overview: A Viennese actor has a stressful time on a student film set in Belfast.

1689831.title: I Have A Name
1689831.overview: I HAVE A NAME is a powerful, true-story-inspired drama that follows Gary and Lily as a simple act of compassion—taking in a young foster child—pulls them into a complex system that forever changes their lives. As they navigate the harsh realities of foster care, including abuse, separation, and trauma, the film offers a raw, honest look at a broken system while calling for awareness, compassion, and change.

1690087.title: Holy Defiance
1690087.overview: Since 2024, on central squares in many towns and cities across Croatia, groups of primarily elderly and middle-aged men calling themselves 'The Knights of the Immaculate Heart of Mary', gather together in communal prayer and advocating for Christian values, the importance of the patriarchy and enforcing limitations of women's rights, treating these squares as their own personal battlefield, upon which women have no place. Through the documentations of the reactions of law enforcement officials, ordinary passerbys and the 'Knights' themselves, as well as the defiant pieces of multimedia artist Arijana Lekić, Holy Defiance creates a vivid, lively, energetic and varied portrait of women's rights in post-war Croatia.

1691303.title: The Doll Ghawiah
1691303.overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.
1691303.trailerName: Teaser Trailer The Doll Ghawiah - Di Bioskop Mulai 29 Oktober 2026

1691495.title: Hajatan Setan
1691495.overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

1693287.title: Fatal Contact
1693287.overview: A traumatized psychic, after receiving a vision from beyond the grave, must use her ability once again to confront a killer.

1693607.title: Hostage
1693607.overview: When a routine cleanup goes wrong, three lifelong friends working for a ruthless crime syndicate must outwit their own boss after realizing they've accidentally killed the one man they were ordered to keep alive.

1696039.title: I Probably Am a Lonely One
1696039.overview: A wife tries to find some kind of connection with her husband, Edward, to no avail.

1697255.title: The Dream: Love & War
1697255.overview: "The Dream: Love & War" is an Indian romantic action drama film that follows the journey of Arin, a young man caught between ambition, love, and conflict. As he struggles to achieve his dreams, his life changes after meeting Sia, whose presence brings both hope and emotional challenges. Set against themes of romance, sacrifice, betrayal, and survival, the story explores how love and war can shape a person’s destiny. The film combines emotional storytelling with dramatic action and relationship-driven conflicts.
1697255.trailerName: Love and War | Official Trailer |Alia Bhatt | Ranbir Kapoor | Vicky Kaushal | Upcoming Film |Concept

1697511.title: Happy Birthday, I Guess...
1697511.overview: On her 23rd birthday, Amaia says nothing to see who remembers. Her roommates ignore her and her family lets her down. Fed up, she orders a pizza, sparking a surreal night with the only person who wishes her a happy birthday: the delivery guy.

1697575.title: Medusa
1697575.overview: Poseidon demands Medusa’s submission. Hoping to protect her, her sisters send her to live with the priestesses of Athena’s temple. But the god of the sea emerges from the waves and rapes the young woman, defiling the temple. To punish her for this desecration, Athena turns Medusa into a monstrous creature: her hair becomes a nest of snakes and her gaze turns anyone who looks at her to stone. This terrifying power arouses the lust of heroes, who pursue her in her exile…

1698215.title: The Final Battle
1698215.overview: In the early days of liberation, banditry is rampant. Xiang Yang, a reconnaissance platoon leader of the People's Liberation Army, is ordered to go to Sanwanli to suppress bandits. Going undercover, he reunites with his elder brother Xiang Tian, who has become the third leader of the bandit gang Qingfeng Stronghold, and they have a fierce confrontation. Yang remains steadfast in his convictions as he outwits intelligence, burns the granary, and coordinates with his comrades outside to launch a siege. Facing the brutal counterattacks of bandit leaders like Blind Long, Yang leads troops to fight bloody battles. With the sacrifice of his brother Tian, they finally completely wipe out the bandit gang. After the battle of blood and fire, this land finally welcomes the dawn of peace.

1698599.title: WAGER
1698599.overview: Cain joined in an illegal underground fight, a fight to the death for a huge money hoping the huge prize will change his life. But in the ring, the contender was his long lost friend. After years separated, they meet on the ring that they cannot leave until the other one is dead.

1699815.title: Tracing Paper
1699815.overview: Follow the preservation of vintage paper through past, present, and future.

1702055.title: Fabric
1702055.overview: Amid the glamour and chaos of New York Fashion Week, a photographer and a model trade access and beauty as they yearn for a real connection.

1702759.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Carmen
1702759.overview: Under the oppressive heat of the Spanish sun, the fiercely independent Carmen attracts the attention of Don José. She warns him not to fall in love with her, but his obsession knows no bounds. Damiano Michieletto’s searing production returns, casting scorching light on the lust, violence and destructive desire of Bizet’s ever-popular opera. An all-star cast brings this white-hot drama to life, with Ginger Costa-Jackson in the fiery title role, alongside Russell Thomas as the jealous and despairing Don José. Following his 2023 Royal Opera debut, Sesto Quatrini returns to conduct Bizet’s electrifying and sensual score.

1703079.title: The Eternal Silence
1703079.overview: An philosophical film assembled from archival NASA footage exploring humanity’s search for meaning in the silence of space.
1703079.trailerName: The Eternal Silence — Apollo Space & Archival Film | Trailer

1703271.title: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
1703271.overview: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

1705191.title: On Air
1705191.overview: When a quiet audio engineering student teams up with a classmate to record a podcast for a school project, he finds himself pulled into a flirtatious battle of wit and vulnerability when the “test interview” becomes all too real.
1705191.trailerName: On Air | A Blushroom Short Film

1705511.title: Her First Taste
1705511.overview: Wen Yuwen, a cute and naive high school girl, loves Chinese far more than math. She tentatively steps into billiard halls, clothing stores and hotels — places of the adult world. She also begins to confront growing pains: relationships with the opposite sex, studying abroad, and her father’s infidelity. Confused yet brave at times, she embarks on a stumbling adventure of youth.

1706087.title: Ayman, Unscripted
1706087.overview: Not every experience leaves a trace, but some quietly change you, and you rarely know which until long after. Unscripted Ayman is a personal and reflective documentary that revisits one man's time in El Jadida, the people he met, the things he learned about himself, and the slow realization that meaning doesn't always show itself in the moment it's lived. It's a film about looking back and asking: was I simply passing through, or did it truly matter? A short poetic documentary by Framed in Marrakech. Watch here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cs6tzfmi0rg&t=96s
1706087.trailerName: Do you dare to ask yourself? Ayman, Unscripted | Official Trailer

1706151.title: Welcome to Borovia
1706151.overview: Harry Enfield heads a brilliant cast in this quirky political comedy where plots, counterplots and seduction flourish in faraway Borovia.

1707431.title: Picasso's Mermaid
1707431.overview: Mary accidentally discovers a mermaid drawn on the wall of her small apartment in Warsaw. It turns out it was drawn by Pablo Picasso during his visit in 1948! She's thrilled, but she doesn't realize the mermaid will turn her life upside down.

1708583.title: Economy-Man: Black Friday
1708583.overview: Distraught with emotion after letting Mr. Knoflick destroy half the universe, Economy-Man sits at a crossroads, knowing he must stop Knoflick before the entire economy is destroyed but searching for a team who can help him beat this seemingly unassailable foe. Meanwhile, three other lost heroes lives intersect with his: Loggo, searching for his best friend, who thinks he is dead; Fry-Man, grieving after giving up the mask after the tragic death of his girlfriend, Gwel; and Bob the Soap, a once proud warrior who finds himself lonelier than ever. The four heroes, shrouded with loneliness, will band together to stop Knoflick from destroying the economy, but can they defeat him and his army before it's too late? The entire Economy-Man saga has led to this.
1708583.trailerName: Economy Man: Black Friday | Official Teaser 2

1708839.title: Her Husband's Double Life
1708839.overview: Carrie's world is shattered when her husband is found critically injured in a car crash with another woman by his side--a woman who also claims to be his wife. Carrie discovers that someone will stop at nothing to erase her from the picture.

1709927.title: Blood Moon
1709927.overview: Across a single night, a ghost and a vampire drift through a haunting, music-driven meditation on belonging, finding love, tragedy and resurrection in a living–dying–living world.

1711207.title: Rewind
1711207.overview: After being left a box of junk, Finn discovers a watch with a unique ability.

1712423.title: Mad Rush
1712423.overview: A young woman gets caught in an elaborate phone scam which sends her on a twisted odyssey through the Melbourne CBD.

1713447.title: Potato Salad
1713447.overview: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

1715303.title: Enjoy the tropix and have a banana !
1715303.overview: Screenshots of the reality of an islander who enjoys having at the expense of being — like a twist of fate, as if trapped in a hamster wheel, where our slightest desire has to be satisfied now, perhaps in the hope of compensating for all the days without. Welcome to “the Tropics”! Where the paradoxes of neocolonial daily life are at work in a suffocating economic and health context.

1717351.title: Creative Differences
1717351.overview: A rock band are sent to a countryside retreat to write their next album.

1717543.title: Housepainter
1717543.overview: A paroled house painter in Venice Beach's life brutally falls apart over the course of a few bad days.

1717671.title: Monkey Graveyard
1717671.overview: Phorn, a middle-aged orangutan caretaker working in a military zoo, confronts an unprecedented tragedy as the orangutan in his care has committed suicide.

1718887.title: Dear Mothers!
1718887.overview: As three generations of Colombian women prepare for their daughter's quinceañera in London, the daughter faces the unexpected reality of her pregnancy and whether to reveal it on the day meant to honour her, risking a celebration that would forever change.

1721255.title: City of Palys
1721255.overview: The film introduces architect Jurgis Rimvydas Palys, his multifaceted world, and the city of Kaunas, which he spent his entire life shaping.

1722407.title: Daydream Sequence
1722407.overview: Two lovers converse at the end of time.

1723751.title: Le meilleur du festival We Love Green

1723815.title: Smile Back
1723815.overview: In this experimental silent short, a young couple's carefree day concludes with a shocking act, leading to a hallucinogenic transition from this life to the next.

1723879.title: The Fox and the Grapes
1723879.overview: A fox attempts to eat some delicious grapes, an Aesops Fables
1723879.trailerName: The Fox and The Grapes Official trailer

1724263.title: Be Mine
1724263.overview: A group of friends anxiously await their Valentine's Day party while a masked killer roams about.

1724647.title: my father is a tofu
1724647.overview: A son visited the tofu factory to see his father, who worked there. As they followed the series of steps in the tofu making process, they shared stories about dreams they had once pursued, fears they had faced, and things they had to let go of to keep life moving forward. From that conversation, the son began to see that his father’s life was no different from the tofu he made every day. Both were born from a long process, endured various pressures, and continued to change shape over time.

1725543.title: When Will You Be Back?
1725543.overview: A quiet journey through hand-drawn memories of a familiar, bygone Hanoi, where a grandson gradually comes to understand his grandmother’s life of waiting, uncovering the weight of a question he can no longer answer.

1726759.title: Michael: Part Two
1726759.overview: The journey of a global icon continues. Following his ascent to solo superstardom, Michael finds himself at the pinnacle of his influence, navigating a world where his every move is captured by the lens of history. As the boundaries between his private life and his public persona blur, he embarks on his most ambitious creative chapters yet, pushing the limits of artistry and innovation in an ever-changing landscape.

1728487.title: Deconstructing Guilherme
1728487.overview: A brief yet exciting journey through the most memorable moments in the life of Guilherme Gomes - creator of  "A Psique de Guilherme" - during the celebrations of its 4th anniversary.

1730215.title: City Lights
1730215.overview: Follows two individuals who move from a village to Bengaluru, only to confront the harsh realities of survival in a fast-paced, indifferent city.

1732647.title: Summertime Sadness
1732647.overview: A woman's quarter life crisis is exacerbated by the sweltering summer heat.

1733031.title: The Grasp Dark Within
1733031.overview: A 19-year-old man is trapped between a dark force in his mind and a small positive energy fighting to save him. As both sides battle for control, his reality distorts, forcing him into a psychological struggle for survival.
1733031.trailerName: The Grasp Dark Within | Official Teaser |ft.Mr Ahmad |@BlueflixProduction

1733607.title: Respirer une fois sur trois
1733607.overview: In group strength-training classes, people breathe in unison every day. Charlyne lifts weights alongside three retired women who love to sing.

1735591.title: AAA Verano de Escándalo 2026 - Week 2
1735591.overview: Week 2 of AAA Verano de Escándalo from Aguascalientes features a AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match as Rey Fenix clashes against Mini Vikingo. Plus, La Parka, Mecha Wolf, and Lince Dorado battle for a spot at Triplemanía and the opportunity to challenge for the AAA Latin American Championship. Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.
cast: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr.

1736103.title: Joyride Returns
1736103.overview: Rusty Nail returns 12 years later, to turn the desert road of the Arizona in blood, as a group of friends on vacation go to a small town near the mountains to explore them, as Rusty Nail with his black truck is near.

1737831.title: Strong Son
1737831.overview: A former South Asian bodybuilder moves back in with his aging father to become his primary caregiver, forcing him to balance the physical strength that once defined him with the mental and emotional challenges of caring for the man who raised him.

1739303.title: My Sad Dead
1739303.overview: Based on the work from Mariana Enriquez and directed by Pablo Larraín, My Sad Dead follows Ema, who can see and hear the dead. After her mother’s death, Ema receives an unexpected visit from her niece Julie, with whom she shares the same unsettling gift. With Julie’s return, family secrets and wounds that never fully healed will resurface —but so will a strange phenomenon from which no one will emerge unscathed. The entire neighborhood will sense presences and hear the distinctive sounds of their own dead.

1744615.title: How I Killed My Self In 3 Days
1744615.overview: A lonely over-thinker conceives a meticulous plan to tidy his affairs over the course of three days so that he can end his life.

1745959.title: HYSTERIA
1745959.overview: Between subway rides and afternoons in the park, a young man and a young woman share simple moments of a seemingly ordinary routine. Gestures, glances, and brief encounters silently reveal a relationship defined by affection and longing.

1746471.title: Nichts wie weg
1746471.overview: Nurse Anke Bender reacts decisively to inappropriate behavior. After a patient gropes her, she slaps him. Unfortunately, the patient turns out to be none other than Hamburg’s health senator, who dies the very next day following an incorrectly administered IV. To avoid arrest, Anke impulsively flees in an ambulance—unaware that the injured pianist Luise Dobertin is inside.

1746535.title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
1746535.overview: This epic documentary reveals how bold artistic choices, behind-the-scenes conflicts, and groundbreaking ideas came together to create an enduring television classic. Through exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, The Sixty-Year Mission uncovers that truth is indeed stranger than science-fiction.

1747687.title: RE/ROUTE
1747687.overview: Blending documentary footage with striking visual collage, RE/ROUTE imagines two competing visions of urban life. One is ruled by cars, productivity, unchecked capitalism and individualism; the other prioritizes connection, leisure and inclusion. As familiar cityscapes morph into surreal tableaux, the film invites us to reconsider how urban design shapes our communities, our relationships, our futures.

1748007.title: Niu Lai
1748007.overview: The naive calf Niu Lai loves exploring the grasslands, but struggles to live up to his family’s expectations as future leader of the herd. With migration fast approaching, Niu Lai finds unlikely allies on his journey to learn the meaning of courage as they prepare for a dangerous trek across the desert.

1748263.title: Biophilia
1748263.overview: When a brilliant botanist is pushed to the brink by his emotionally abusive husband's emotional abuse, he synthesizes a custom hallucinogen designed to force his tormentor to viscously experience his his own abuse first hand.

1750439.title: Akshara
1750439.trailerName: AKSHARA | Movie Official Trailer 2026 | Sushil Sitaula, Nancy Khadka, Sushil Pokharel, Rista Basnet

1751015.title: Passará
1751015.overview: In this short film resulted of a exchange between artists from Brazil and South Korea, an inattentive man must face the world around him after being transformed into a bird.

1752487.title: Petros Eni
1752487.overview: In an immersion into the little-known Necropolis upon which the foundations of St. Peter's Basilica rest, we will learn the story of the tomb of the first apostle. The first Pope, the "rock" upon which all of Christianity was built and which has cemented the history not only of the Catholic religion, but of all Western civilization. A fascinating journey through a sacred place that has survived for millennia and whose history is intertwined with the life of the apostle himself and the construction of the Basilica, which in 2026, when Petros Eni arrives in the rooms, will celebrate the 400th anniversary of its inauguration.

1754151.title: Try Hard
1754151.overview: Mira, a 24 year old university student tackles the pressures of Tall Poppy Syndrome (TPS) enacted by her peers at university whilst simultaneously trying to live up to the contrasting expectations of her immigrant parents. Unable to satisfy either side, Mira's internalises the conflict until it becomes too much to bear. With the support of her best friend Jess, Mira finally speaks up and regains her autonomy.

1754663.title: Switches
1754663.overview: Jake and Dawn, a married couple sliding towards divorce. Two people who once had it all--the career momentum, the chemistry, the “it couple” energy-- are now buried under bills, resentment, and distance. Enter Switch, the trial drug from a hush-hush pharmaceutical company promising an “empathy revolution” by letting couples swap consciousness for 24 hours.

1755303.title: The Rootman
1755303.overview: In the deepening twilight of the autumn forest, seven-year-old Lilly is searching for her older sister, Nora. Guided by the light of the Rootman – an enigmatic being – she encounters the mysterious inhabitants of the woods. Will Lilly find her sister?

1755943.title: Simulacro
1755943.overview: A director returns to his childhood home to recreate, with actors, the argument that drove his parents apart when he was four years old. Through improvisation and a film shoot that reveals his own artifice, he builds memories to which he never had access. But as the scene repeats itself, the indications lose their clarity and the border between reconstruction and desire start to blur.

1756519.title: Jakob & Anxiety
1756519.overview: Jacob, aged 22, navigates his way through everyday situations, constantly accompanied by Anxiety, an intrusive and manipulative presence that only he can see.  When Jacob is reunited with Mille, a girl from his past, he is forced to confront the voice that has controlled his life.  In a surreal inner journey where fantasy and reality merge, Jacob learns that anxiety cannot be eradicated—but it can be faced, named and lived with. The film blends realism, humour and visual metaphor to explore vulnerability, mental health and the courage it takes to let someone see who you really are.

1756903.title: Sand Roads
1756903.overview: SAND ROADS is a journey told in two chapters - one filled with the spirit of youth; the other imbued with the weight of adulthood - showing the eternal struggle for self-discovery, adventure and how friendships can transcend life itself.

1758055.title: The Kaoliao Breakout
1758055.overview: Adapted from the infamous Kaohsiung Prison riot in Taiwan, this story follows six inmates who plot a daring jailbreak to protest the injustices of the judicial system.

1759079.title: The Gambit
1759079.overview: Tony, a middle-aged man, is sitting at a table with a chessboard setup. Brent, in his early twenties, walks into the cafe and takes a seat across from Tony. They play a game of chess while they talk about business, through the lens of chess. Tony is clearly a veteran that has been playing a long time, and knows his way around the board. Brent is new to the game, but has a creativity and strategy that Tony can’t read.

1760679.title: An Esker in the Sun
1760679.overview: A short documentary about the environmental art exhibition Oranki Art, set in the northern wilderness. People arrive, depart and age, while the artworks remain and decay. The film lingers on the moments when new works are born and become part of the seemingly eternal landscape.

1760743.title: Blue Danube
1760743.overview: In Lezama, fashion designer Óscar Barbosa defied the social norms of his time and environment, becoming synonymous with fashion and sexual identity. In the 1960s, he returned to his hometown with his partner, which would spark an artistic adventure that marked a before and after in the local community. "Danubio azul" is a kaleidoscope of stories that intertwine, contradict one another, and pile up to sketch the profile of a man who, over time, became a myth.

1762983.title: The Informant
1762983.overview: Eighty-two-year-old Juris Kalniņš has found his name in the archives of the Committee for State Security of the Latvian SSR, where he is identified as an informant. Both during the Soviet era and today, he remains an uncompromising free thinker who has devoted most of his life to photographing people and documenting the spirit of the times. With the camera now turned towards Juris, he is ready to delve into his past to understand how his name could have ended up on a KGB file. What makes a person an informant – a piece of paper, mere suspicion, the opinions of others, or one’s own actions?

1768359.title: How to Survive the Summer Holidays
1768359.overview: At a Kashubian campsite, surrounded by a lake and a forest, where families, couples, and singles come searching for a holiday break, new relationships form and conflicts escalate. Some fall in love, whilst others begin to resent each other. While the adults struggle to communicate, the children, left to their own devices, construct a world of their own, fuelled by Kashubian legends and scary stories. When, one morning, holidaymakers discover punctured tyres on their cars, the atmosphere thickens and mutual animosities come to the fore.

1768743.title: Подземия и котаци: Да живее кралят
